Fictitious/system Organizations, attribution of platform-global actions to an operator login Organization, shared tenant/global audit authority and universal coverage claims not proven by the producer inventory
objective: Implement dual-scope durable append-only audit records for security-sensitive human, AI and system actions without replacing domain authority. TENANT scope requires Organization ownership, PostgreSQL forced RLS, nexus_runtime authority, tenant RBAC and P04 transactional outbox. PLATFORM scope requires null Organization identity, dedicated least-privilege persistence and query authority, registered platform provenance and durable ingestion including authoritative Sentinel privileged facts. Independent integrity domains, typed bounded metadata, deterministic replay conflict detection and tamper-evident verification protect both scopes. The Master Orchestrator dual-scope decision supersedes P22-SD01; ADR-0103 and the P22 design define the updated acceptance contract.
